lines.text: Complaint No. 05-0157-955 File Number

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: How much time did you think it took from when you cut her on the neck to the time you guys got her out in the garage?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: 'bout ten minutes.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: After, after the fire was, and she was put in fire, what time did you go home to your place that night?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: About 9:30.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Did you come back out at all that night?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: (shakes head “no”) uh uh.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Was Steven out there when you went home?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Yeah. Cuz he said he was gonna watch the fire until it burnt down a little bit more.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: What did you guys do with Teresa’s body after that, after it was burned?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: I don’t know, I didn’t, I didn’t do nothin’ with it.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Did Steven do anything with it?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Yeah, but I don’t know what.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: How do you, what do you mean by yes, but you don’t know what?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Like he tried to bury it or somethin’.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: How’d he do that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: With the shovel.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Did he take some of her body out of that fire pit?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: (nods “yes”) Yeah.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: He did. How tell me how he did that.
